## Description

What does this pull request change, and why? Link the issue or discussion
it resolves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (wrong number, wrong term, broken link or broken command)
- [ ] New feature (skill capability, template, integration)
- [ ] Docs (guides, FAQ, examples, hook library)
- [ ] Tooling (CI, Makefile, templates, test protocol)

## How has this been tested?

Say what you actually ran. Docs-only changes: note that CI lint and link
checks cover them. Renderer or protocol changes: name the tool and
version, and point at the test-protocol artifacts you produced.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat, fix, docs,
      chore, test)
- [ ] Style respected: markdown, 80-character soft wrap, no trailing
      whitespace, no emoji
- [ ] Counts are consistent everywhere (47 hook formulas = 21 + 26,
      5 phases, 12 principles, 16 QA points, 10 onboarding questions)
- [ ] New hook formulas carry a shape, an example, an on-screen version
      and a failure mode
- [ ] markdownlint and link checks pass locally, or the CI run is green
- [ ] Docs updated wherever numbers or terminology changed
